title: Extra-Day Rate by the Customer's Standing with the Network (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Decision rule.** The extra-day rate of the corrected time charge on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network repair depends on the customer's standing with the network: a customer who holds an active network workmanship warranty and has a closed network insurance claim repair takes the class weekly rate divided by 7; a customer who meets exactly one of those two conditions takes the lesser of the class partner daily rate and the class weekly rate divided by 6; any other customer takes the class partner daily rate.

The two conditions are read from the customer's own records with the network: a coverage under Workmanship Warranties whose status is active, and a repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs whose status is closed.

## Decision table

| Active coverage under Workmanship Warranties | Closed repair under Insurance Claim Repairs | Extra-day rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The class weekly rate divided by 7 |
| Yes | No | The lesser of the class partner daily rate and the class weekly rate divided by 6 |
| No | Yes | The lesser of the class partner daily rate and the class weekly rate divided by 6 |
| No | No | The class partner daily rate |

## Rates per class (worked from the class rate schedule, unrounded figures shown to three decimals)

| Rental class | Both conditions (weekly rate divided by 7) | Exactly one (lesser of partner rate and weekly rate divided by 6) | Neither (partner rate) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 32.714 | 38.167 | 39.99 |
| Compact Rental | 35.000 | 40.833 | 42.99 |
| Intermediate Rental | 38.429 | 44.833 | 46.99 |
| Full-Size Rental | 42.714 | 49.833 | 52.99 |
| Standard SUV Rental | 54.143 | 63.167 | 64.99 |
| Minivan Rental | 61.286 | 71.500 | 74.99 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer with an active coverage under Workmanship Warranties and no closed insurance claim repair meets exactly one condition; on an Economy Rental the extra-day rate is the lesser of 39.99 USD and 229.00 USD divided by 6 (38.167 USD), that is 38.167 USD.
- A customer whose only warranty coverage has expired and whose insurance claim repair is closed also meets exactly one condition.
